reason: I already reorder my usual brand when it runs out and my drawer is full of half-used bottles, so I don't need another one. The lab report is a nice touch, but I'd have to check it's real before I changed anything.
objection: Is it really tested, or just marketing? A named lab and a QR code sound good, but I can't tell if the report is real, and it's a brand I've never heard of with a made in China label.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a real batch report from a lab I can look up myself, plus a few honest reviews from verified buyers, and finishing what I already have first.
